settings.mle_locfdr_window: median +- b*sc, then delta0 +- b*sigma0, b = 4.3 exp(-0.26 log10 N)
settings.bulk_condition: p0 >= 0.9 and the axis-block 95% interval of p0 reaches 1
settings.tie_rule: a permuted value within tie_tolerance * max(1, |observed|) of the observed counts as at least as large
settings.z: Phi^-1(F_{m-1}(t)), centred on each axis's mean over fitted cells; axes with fewer than two fitted cells dropped
settings.fit_mask: m >= 2 instructions, spread over instructions above 1e-12, finite t
settings.lambda_definition: median |t| over the grid's non-NaN cells / median |t| pooled over all permuted grids in float64 (registered convention: zero-spread cells count as 0 or infinity)
settings.tau: 100 sqrt(max(mean_j tau2_j, 0)), tau2_j = [sum_c xbar_c^2 - sum_c var_i(x_ci)/n_c] / (k - 1), x the within-instruction centred rate (or the target-base difference of centred rates)

streams.median: reference_free_max_test (argsort of uniform noise per instruction)
